Border and box-sizing

Borders surround the padding. box-sizing controls whether width and height include padding and
border.
content-box එJකේ width එකට padding සහ border එකතු Jවනවා. border-box එJකේ දී declared
width එක තුළම padding සහ border ගන්නවා. Margin එක Jදෙකටම ඇතුළතේ නුහු.
A 200px card must fit exactly in a fixed column.

Read the diagram: 1. A starts with 200px content. 2. B starts with 200px outer border box. 3. B
subtracts padding and border from its content.
පෙළමු box එJකේ content 200px. Jදෙවුනි box එJකේ මුළු border-box එකම 200px නිසා content 156px Jවනවා.
Expected result: A is 244px wide; B is 200px wide (content 156px).

Answer: It makes declared dimensions include padding and border, simplifying layout
calculations.
Remember: border-box = width includes border and padding.
Practice: Set all elements to border-box and inspect a card.
